title: Ternary Cubic and Mixed-Degree Syndrome Corrections: Fermat Exponent Reduction, Arbitrary-Function Low-Rank Classical Simulation, and Exact Single-Point Twirl Pinching

theorems.statement: For any full-row-rank A in F_3^{n x m} with right inverse R (A R = I_n), any independent H in F_3^{r x m} with H A^T = 0 mod 3 (N = 3^r), and any deterministic map F : F_3^r -> F_3^n, the coherent ternary filter with d(b) = R^T b + F(H b) mod 3 has exact output word distribution matching the O(poly(n, m, r) * 9^r) classical block-convolution sampler over cosets e_0 + H^T u.

Over F_3, x^3 = x reduces univariate cubes to linear terms. Any mixed polynomial basis phi_mixed(x) with phi_mixed(0) = 0 containing both odd-degree and even-degree coordinates is strictly injective on F_3^r (phi_mixed(x) == phi_mixed(y) iff x == y), eliminating the y = -x reflection alias of homogeneous quadratics and pinching the z != 0 coefficient-averaged distribution in each occupied block to the exact constant E[P(v | z != 0, e_0)] = (N - 1)/N^2 + (sum_u tilde_sigma_u)^2 / (N^2 B) <= (2N - 1)/N^2 < 2/N.

For full H in F_3^{(m-n) x m} spanning ker(A) (N = 3^{m-n}), E_{F_mixed}[Pr(success | A)] <= V_A / 2^m + 2 V_A / 3^{m-n}, and averaging over IID uniform A in F_3^{n x m} (m >= n) yields E_{A, F_mixed}[Pr(success)] <= 3^{-n} + 2(2/3)^m + (3^n - 1)/(2 * 3^m).
